channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: San Francisco’s milkshake-fueled diner revival, served with a side of nostalgia
item.description: A kitschy trio — Goldenette, Chicken Fried Palace, and Hamburguesa Bar — is scratching the city’s itch for vinyl booths and a retro aesthetic.

item.title: The Warriors gambled on a Steph Curry-Kristaps Porzingis pairing. So far, it’s a flop
item.description: Golden State’s superstar will miss at least five more games with runner’s knee, and its top trade deadline acquisition has only appeared in one game.

item.title: When Peet’s and Starbucks closed, the Castro lost more than coffee
item.description: Marking a changing of the guard in the neighborhood’s cafe scene.

item.title: Robot turtles: Waymo’s next-gen cars could be buggy Hyundai EVs
item.description: The robotaxi company is reportedly buying 50,000 Ioniq 5s. The problem? Owners say their cars keep dying.

item.title: The genius of Ron Washington: The full-circle story of a childhood Giants fan
item.description: The former Rangers and Angels manager said the Giants were the only team willing to hire him after health issues scared other teams away.

item.title: Kafka in court: San Francisco’s legal resistance takes on ICE detentions
item.description: A series of wins showcase a coalition of nonprofits, pro bono lawyers, and others fighting mass deportation.

item.title: She polls near the bottom in the governor’s race. So why do insiders love Betty Yee?
item.description: The former state controller is running as an outsider. Does she have a chance?

item.title: If the 49ers plan to trade Mac Jones, expect a deal this week
item.description: GM John Lynch and coach Kyle Shanahan need clarity before the start of free agency.

item.title: The next hot tenant looking for space in SF? Jeff Bezos’ secret AI shop
item.description: Project Prometheus, which launched just months ago, has raised billions and is on the hunt for a light industrial space.

item.title: Lurie orders elimination of 500 City Hall positions amid budget deficit
item.description: The mayor’s budget director said the city needs to cut at least $100 million in personnel spending.
